notes: Engine-first, sellability/CAC-aware, end-to-end automation and batchability scorecard. Retired after owner feedback on 2026-09-24: v2 over-weighted automation/ease of fulfillment and allowed low-value commodity souvenir products to outrank stronger business opportunities.

commodity_block.rule: If a current direct substitute already provides the same core offer and no evidenced wedge exists, candidate cannot be a top finalist.

low_value_block.rule: Decorative/souvenir/novelty products with weak functional value, low repeat/LTV and no exceptional organic demand cannot become the project final merely because they are easy to automate.

must_show_at_least_two: measurable economic or time benefit to buyer
high absolute gross profit dollars per customer

finalist_requirements: absolute dollar economics, not margin percentage only
scale path beyond one low-value SKU

notes: Value-first business opportunity scorecard. Automation is an enabler, not the definition of opportunity. Explicitly prevents easy-to-generate commodity souvenirs from becoming final recommendations. Retired on 2026-09-24 after ontology failure review: even value-first weights are insufficient unless only true niche-level entities can enter final ranking.

gates.final_output_contract: Rank niches/business opportunities, never individual artifacts, listings, designs, templates, books, posters, apps or other single offers.
finalist_requirements: absolute unit economics and customer economics
repeat/LTV or sufficiently high customer value
scale path for a two-person starting team
multiple possible offers/tests inside the niche

notes: RevEng v4: niche-first ontology enforced in database. Products/offers are test vehicles inside a niche and cannot become final ranked opportunities. Retired after red-team showed pain+WTP+market can still produce crowded me-too categories without a new-entrant advantage.

finalist_requirements: important recurring or high-value buyer problem/job
credible acquisition path and CAC logic
competition/substitutes and reason a new entrant can win
two-person launch feasibility and scale path

entrant_edge_hard_gate.direct_substitute_rule: If current competitors already serve the same buyer with the same proposed wedge and no evidenced entrant edge exists, reject rather than merely subtract points.

notes: RevEng v5: edge-first niche discovery. A real pain/market is not enough; a new entrant must have an evidenced structural advantage before deep screen. Direct me-too substitutes cause rejection, not a soft score penalty. Retired 2026-10-08: global scoring was contaminated by user-specific/false owner-network assumptions; superseded by reveng_v6_independent.

acceptable_edge_types: regulatory license/permission/certification advantage intrinsic to the business model
acquirable owned audience/customer base/partner channel demonstrated independently of the current user
entrant_edge_hard_gate.direct_substitute_rule: If current competitors serve the same buyer with the same wedge and no independent entrant edge exists, reject from deep screen.

global_independence_rule.rule: Global business ranking must be independent of the current user. Personal network, biography, location, capital, licenses, employer, contacts, prior industry experience, private access, or other user-specific assets cannot increase or decrease the global score.

notes: RevEng v6 independent baseline. Global ranking is user-agnostic. User fit may exist only as a separate optional overlay and never mutates global score. Adds DB-enforced score arithmetic integrity.
